# Gramlot examples 0.3.21

- Compare HTML input/html_button and Gramlot textbox/button on the same Data value, including shared labelbox styling, editing modes and Clear actions.
- Simplify Bound forms and Tabs into small composition methods while retaining all controls, bindings, close behavior and 14 tab reference variants.
- Shorten lesson titles, align explanations with the running pages and update the feature coverage checklist.
- Add focused Chromium/WebKit qualification for shared editing, narrow layout, retained tab drafts and close vetoes.

This release updates the examples package and hosted galleries. It retains the PageStore trials from 0.3.20 and does not change the core or server packages. Remote Edit remains disabled on the public galleries.
